label: QR Code
description: Scannable QR from any text (URL, plain string, or structured payload). Defaults to the branded look — circle modules on a light card with the m0saic M carved in the centre; swap the centre asset and URL to make it yours. Square/rounded/circle module styles, light/dark/transparent card, optional spawn animation (Output mp4). The one standalone QR template.

text.label: Text
text.description: Text to encode (URL, plain string, or structured payload). Defaults to https://www.m0saic.io.

outputFormat.label: Output
outputFormat.description: Deliverable format. "png" renders the static QR image; "mp4" renders the spawn animation (modules pixelate in — tune it under Animation).

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Background mode. transparent = alpha PNG for compositing.

moduleStyle.label: Module Style
moduleStyle.description: Module shape: circle dots (the branded default), roundedSquare, or square (the classic matrix look).

moduleColor.label: Module Color
moduleColor.description: Fill colour for data modules and eye dark layers.

style.moduleBorderRadius.label: Module radius
style.moduleBorderRadius.description: Override module corner radius (0..1). Default derives from Module Style.

style.eyeInnerDotBorderRadius.label: Eye dot radius
style.eyeInnerDotBorderRadius.description: Inner eye dot corner radius (0..1). 1.0 = circular dot.

center.show.label: Show Center
center.show.description: Carve a centre into the QR. Off = plain QR, no cutout. Default on.

center.assetPath.label: Asset
center.assetPath.description: Image or video that fills the centre safe area. Empty = the m0saic M (rendered in-house — no file involved); swap in your own logo path (and update the Text URL).

center.paddingPct.label: Padding (%)
center.paddingPct.description: Padding between modules and the centre frame, % of max dim.

center.label: Center Asset
center.description: Carved centre asset: your image or video in the middle; modules carve a safe area around it (ECC H + version floor keep it scannable).

animation.spawnDurMs.label: Spawn (ms)
animation.spawnDurMs.description: Stagger: time from first to last tile starting its fade-in.

animation.holdDurMs.label: Hold (ms)
animation.holdDurMs.description: Hold at full alpha before fade-out (used when Fade out > 0).

animation.fadeOutDurMs.label: Fade out (ms)
animation.fadeOutDurMs.description: Global fade-out. 0 = spawn in and hold to the end of the render.

animation.tileOffsetPx.label: Settle (px)
animation.tileOffsetPx.description: Per-tile pixel offset that decays to 0 during fade-in.

animation.gleam.label: Module Gleam
animation.gleam.description: Travelling per-cell shine over the data modules during the hold. Cells dip to a high alpha floor, so the code stays scannable. Eyes and the centre are untouched. Requires Output mp4.

animation.label: Animation
animation.description: Spawn-animation envelope (active when Output is "mp4"): modules pixelate in with a staggered fade. Size the render duration to at least spawn + fade + hold (+ fade out).

advanced.svg.label: SVG string
advanced.svg.description: Caller-supplied SVG string — bypasses QR generation (testing, non-QR vector content, pre-generated QRs). Styling/center are ignored; animation still applies.

advanced.driftPercent.label: Drift %
advanced.driftPercent.description: Drift tolerance for SVG grid inference (% of min canvas dim).

version.label: QR Version
version.description: Force QR version (1–40). Default auto; a centre cutout forces ≥6. Bump higher if a printed code fails to scan.
